aiAgents.metaDescription: AI agents that execute tasks across CRM, email, and billing for professional services firms in Mexico — no manual follow-ups or copy-paste. | Breakaway
aiAgents.heroSubtitle: Not chatbots for the sake of it — agents that read context, take action in the tools you already use, and leave an auditable trail of every step.
aiAgents.infoIntro: We design agent ecosystems around one concrete process first: a supervisor that decides what happens next, and specialized agents that execute each task with clear permissions.

aiAgents.feature2Desc: Update a status, draft a follow-up, route a request, trigger an invoice. The agent <highlight>writes where your team would write</highlight>, with rules you define upfront.
aiAgents.feature3Desc: Every action is logged. Sensitive steps can require human approval. You always know <highlight>who did what and when</highlight> — including the agent.

aiAgents.deliverable2: Supervisor + operational agents connected to your stack

aiAgents.timelineNote: First agent running on one process: typically 4–6 weeks.
aiAgents.ctaHeadline: Which process should an agent own first?
aiAgents.ctaText: Tell us the workflow nobody wants to inherit. We'll tell you if an agent is the right fit — or if something simpler works better.

escritos-sat.title: Escritos SAT
escritos-sat.description: Fiscal document generation platform for accounting and legal firms in Mexico.
escritos-sat.heroSubtitle: Fiscal document generation platform for firms
escritos-sat.heroHeadline: Fiscal document generation,<highlight> without chasing folders</highlight>
escritos-sat.heroDescription: Centralizes firm operations: organizes case files in OneDrive, responds to SAT requirements, and drafts legal filings with fiscal AI — without inventing information.
escritos-sat.heroAudience: Built for fiscal firms in Mexico
escritos-sat.problemHeadline: Information lives in three places and deadlines don't wait
escritos-sat.problemDescription: OneDrive, Excel, and email become the default source of truth. When a SAT requirement arrives or a spontaneous IVA refund filing is due, teams lose days building folders, tracking numerales, and drafting responses by hand.
escritos-sat.featuresHeadline: The full fiscal workflow in one platform
escritos-sat.feature1Description: Upload the SAT PDF, extract numerales automatically, and generate per-annex checklists — with the compliant folder structure already created.
escritos-sat.feature2Description: Templates aligned to IVA refunds: taxable activities, 16% and 0% rates, creditable IVA, and supporting documentation.
escritos-sat.feature3Description: Native OneDrive for Business integration. The digital case file in the cloud and the filing status always match.
escritos-sat.feature4Description: Assisted drafting in Mexican fiscal-legal tone. Analyzes supporting PDFs and generates drafts citing real evidence — no invented data.
escritos-sat.stepsHeadline: From requirement to draft in three steps
escritos-sat.step1Description: Load the SAT requirement or start a spontaneous filing. The platform identifies numerales and filing type.
escritos-sat.step2Description: OneDrive folder structure and per-numeral checklists are created — no manual file naming.
escritos-sat.step3Description: AI drafts the filing citing supporting documentation. You review, adjust, and save directly to the case file.
escritos-sat.ctaHeadline: Does your firm handle IVA refunds?
escritos-sat.ctaDescription: Book a demo and we'll see if Escritos SAT fits your operation — no commitment.

multicotizador.title: MultiCotizador
multicotizador.description: White-label platform to quote, compare, and issue auto insurance across multiple carriers in Mexico.
multicotizador.heroHeadline: Quote, compare, and issue,<highlight> without opening eight portals</highlight>
multicotizador.heroDescription: One form queries Mexico's major insurers in parallel. Your client compares prices side by side, downloads the comparative PDF, and issues the policy online — all from a platform with your branding.
multicotizador.heroAudience: Built for insurance brokers and agencies in Mexico
multicotizador.problemHeadline: Auto quoting is still manual and fragmented
multicotizador.problemDescription: Every carrier has its own portal, vehicle catalog, and issuance flow. Advisors waste time re-entering data, clients can't compare apples to apples, and follow-up lives across Excel, email, and WhatsApp.
multicotizador.featuresHeadline: From quoter to issuance in one platform
multicotizador.feature1Description: Query AXA, GNP, HDI, MAPFRE, Quálitas, Chubb, Zurich, TuMomento, and more in parallel — with a single form for personal data, location, and vehicle.
multicotizador.feature2Description: Quotation grid with price, coverage package, and discounts. Per-carrier detail: term, deductibles, insured amount, and vehicle homologation when catalogs don't match.
multicotizador.feature3Description: Generate and download a comparative PDF of all quotes. Automatic branded email delivery — ready to share with the client.
multicotizador.feature4Description: Custom logo, colors, copy, and hero. Admin dashboard for quotes, issuances, users, custom packages, discounts, and per-carrier credentials.
multicotizador.stepsHeadline: From vehicle data to issued policy
multicotizador.step1Description: The client or advisor enters personal data, fiscal location, vehicle, and coverage plan in a guided four-step flow.
multicotizador.step2Description: The platform queries all connected insurers and displays results in a comparative grid with prices and coverages.
multicotizador.step3Description: Download the PDF, send by email, or start online issuance. The admin panel centralizes quotes, issuances, and operational follow-up.
multicotizador.ctaHeadline: Does your agency quote auto across multiple carriers?
multicotizador.ctaDescription: Book a demo and we'll see how MultiCotizador fits your operation — no commitment.

avaluos.title: Avalúos
avaluos.description: End-to-end platform for real estate appraisals in Mexico: AI catastro extraction, comparables, homologation, and official documents in Google Drive.
avaluos.heroSubtitle: Real estate appraisal management for certified appraisers
avaluos.heroHeadline: From catastro screenshots to official appraisal,<highlight> without chasing folders</highlight>
avaluos.heroDescription: Centralize every expediente: extract catastro data with AI, search comparables on property portals, homologate values, and generate pre-appraisal, individual appraisal, and final delivery — with a Drive folder and spreadsheet per case.
avaluos.heroAudience: Built for appraisal firms and certified valuators in Mexico
avaluos.problemHeadline: The appraisal lives in five places and deadlines don't wait
avaluos.problemDescription: Catastro in screenshots, comparables manually pulled from Inmuebles24, homologation in Excel, photos in Drive, and the report in Google Docs. Each case goes through seven phases with no single source of truth and no clear ownership per step.
avaluos.featuresHeadline: The full valuation workflow in one platform
avaluos.feature1Description: Upload catastro screenshots or Excel; AI extracts cadastral key, surfaces, owners, and location. You review, confirm, and export to Google Sheets.
avaluos.feature2Description: AI search on Inmuebles24 and Propiedades.com. One comparable per property label, with verifiable URL, price, and surface area.
avaluos.feature3Description: AI calculates adjustment factors for area, location, condition, and age. Individual or bulk manual adjustments; value list generation in Drive.
avaluos.feature4Description: Pre-appraisal, individual appraisal, tax folios, and final appraisal from templates. Drive folder and collaborative spreadsheet per expediente.
avaluos.stepsHeadline: From new expediente to delivered appraisal
avaluos.step1Title: Create the case and extract catastro
avaluos.step1Description: Register client, priority, and properties. Upload Excel or screenshots; AI completes catastro data and creates folder + spreadsheet in Drive.
avaluos.step2Description: AI searches market comparables, you validate, run homologation, and approve the preliminary value list.
avaluos.step3Description: Schedule field visit, capture physical values, photos, and sketches. Generate individual appraisal, tax folios, final report, and mark as delivered.
avaluos.ctaHeadline: Does your firm manage appraisals with manual comparables?
avaluos.ctaDescription: Book a demo and we'll see how Avalúos fits your operation — no commitment.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce Platform
ecommerce.description: E-commerce platform with purchase, rental, and subscriptions: catalog, mixed cart, Stripe payments, shipping, and full admin panel.

ecommerce.problemHeadline: Selling online with rentals and subscriptions shouldn't require five systems
ecommerce.problemDescription: WooCommerce doesn't handle deposit-based rentals. Shopify doesn't manage monthly subscription shipments. You end up with catalog on one side, payments on another, shipping in Excel, and rentals in email — no single source of truth for the order.
ecommerce.featuresHeadline: From catalog to delivered order in one platform
ecommerce.feature1Description: Direct purchase, deposit-based rental, and monthly subscriptions coexist in the same experience — the customer chooses per product without leaving the flow.
ecommerce.feature2Description: Stripe Checkout Sessions, recurring subscriptions, automatic webhooks, and price sync with the catalog — without rebuilding billing logic.
ecommerce.feature3Description: Shipping address at checkout, per-order tracking, and monthly subscription shipment management with carrier, tracking number, and status pipeline.
ecommerce.feature4Description: Catalog, categories, sales, rentals with returns, subscriptions, customers, charts, and CSV export — all from one dashboard.
ecommerce.step1Description: The customer filters by category and chooses purchase, rental, or subscription per product. Adds to cart — mixed modalities in one order.
ecommerce.step2Description: Guided checkout: personal data, shipping address, rental documents if applicable, and secure Stripe payment — one-time or recurring.
ecommerce.step3Description: The customer tracks orders, rentals, and subscription shipments from their profile. Admin operates catalog, fulfillment, and reports from the panel.

aboutPage.heroPhotoAlt: Breakaway's three founders at the Centro de Congresos in Querétaro
aboutPage.introText: We studied Computer Science and Technologies at Tec de Monterrey, Querétaro campus, and founded Breakaway before we graduated. Today we have agent ecosystems running in production.
aboutPage.storyHeadline: Our first client arrived before our degrees did.
aboutPage.storyText1: They hired us while we were still students, for a project bigger than anything we had built until then. We took it, delivered it and put it into production.
aboutPage.storyText2: Then so much work came in that there were weeks when deliveries mattered more than classes. After graduating we went all in on Breakaway. We still work the same way: we commit to the outcome and build whatever it takes to reach it.
aboutPage.storyPhotoAlt: The founders on graduation day at Tec de Monterrey
aboutPage.foundersIntro: There's no middle layer. All three founders work on the projects and answer to the client directly.
aboutPage.foundersDegree: Computer Science and Technologies · Tec de Monterrey
aboutPage.founder1Desc: Responsible for the architecture of the agent ecosystems and the technical decisions behind every implementation.
aboutPage.founder2Desc: Responsible for the company's direction, its financial structure and the commercial scope of every project.
aboutPage.founder3Desc: Responsible for operations and for making sure every delivery reaches production on time and working.

privacyPage.label: Legal
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy describes how Breakaway AI ("Breakaway", "we") handles personal data on our website and in the WhatsApp assistants we operate. By using these services, you agree to this policy.
privacyPage.whoBody: Breakaway AI builds and operates AI agents for companies. Contact: general@breakaway.work.
privacyPage.scopeBody: This policy covers the breakaway.work website (or the domain where this page is published), our contact form, and our WhatsApp Business / WhatsApp Cloud API channels, including the assistant that answers queries (for example, weather) and conversations our team may view or continue in the WhatsApp Business app.
privacyPage.dataBody:
Website and form: name, company (optional), WhatsApp, and the message you send us.

WhatsApp: phone number, message content (text and, if sent, files or media), technical IDs Meta sends with the webhook (such as message IDs), and, if you ask for weather, the city you name.

We do not ask for passwords, payment cards, or government IDs for these services.
privacyPage.purposeBody: To respond to your commercial inquiry, operate the chat, generate an automatic reply, let Breakaway staff read and continue the conversation, and keep the service running. The bases are providing the service you request by contacting us, and our legitimate interest in operating sales and support.
privacyPage.whatsappBody: Messages travel on WhatsApp. Meta processes them under their own terms. We receive them via the WhatsApp Cloud API. See WhatsApp's privacy policy (whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy) and Meta's (facebook.com/privacy/policy).
privacyPage.aiBody: Automatic replies may be generated by a language model through our infrastructure (for example Vercel AI Gateway). Message text is sent to that model to produce an answer. We do not sell chats or use them to train public models beyond what those providers state in their own policies.
privacyPage.sharingBody: We do not sell personal data or use it for third-party ads. We share it only with Meta/WhatsApp (the channel), hosting, email, and AI providers needed to run the service, and Breakaway staff who handle the inbox. The contact form is processed with our email provider (Resend) to notify us and, where applicable, record you as a lead.
privacyPage.retentionBody: We keep data as long as needed to handle the conversation or commercial request and for a reasonable support or audit period, unless the law requires longer. We then delete or anonymize it.
privacyPage.rightsBody:
You may request access or deletion by emailing general@breakaway.work and including your email or WhatsApp number. We will delete what we store about that chat or lead, except what we must keep by law. Deleting the thread on your phone does not automatically delete our server copy.

This page also serves as user data deletion instructions for Meta App Review.
privacyPage.childrenBody: These services are not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country).
privacyPage.changesBody: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the current version.
